title: Minutes From Old Town Scottsdale, Sleeps 20
description:
Welcome to your dream escape in the heart of South Scottsdale! This stunning 8-bedroom, four-bath Villa offers luxury living at its finest, comfortably sleeping up to 20 guests. 

Step outside into the backyard oasis featuring a sparkling heated pool with seating for relaxing and dining. Whether you’re lounging poolside or gathering around with friends and family, this Villa offers the perfect setting for having a great time..
Walking distance to Old Town Scottsdale. License 2039358

 The space 
Experience true luxury living in our stunning Scottsdale villa, boasting a private heated swimming pool and an upscale outdoor grilling area, complemented by a stylish alfresco dining setup. This pristine property is designed for modern living, showcasing high-end finishes juxtaposed with chic decor – comfort and class blend seamlessly here.

Relax in our spacious living room, featuring plush seating and a large flat-screen TV. It's the perfect space for unwinding and sharing laughter with your loved ones after a day of Scottsdale's finest attractions. 

Fulfill your culinary desires in our gourmet kitchen. With state-of-the-art stainless steel appliances, gorgeous granite countertops, and ample preparation space, all the tools you need to create delightful dishes are on hand.

Whether you decide to savor your meals around our elegant indoor dining table or soak up the surroundings over dinner on the patio, unforgettable dining moments await you.

Each bedroom is designed with restful sleep as a prime consideration. Luxuriate on our plush beds after an eventful day, with the master bedroom offering the added luxury of an en-suite bathroom complete with a walk-in shower and a sleek, double vanity.

What's more, our villa is well-appointed with amenities catering to your every need, including complimentary WiFi, a washer and dryer, and covered parking for up to two cars with additional guest parking.

Located just a short drive away from renowned golf courses and the vibrant vibe of Downtown Phoenix or Tempe, our villa is the ideal base for friends or family. Walk to Old Town to visit quaint shops and experience gourmet restaurants, with all of what South Scottsdale has to offer just steps away. 

Don't hesitate to book this fantastic villa for your next unforgettable holiday experience! Whether it's a friends trip or a family retreat, we guarantee a memorable escape in the sun-drenched heart of Scottsdale.
